title: Number of Drivers Issued with Summons and Fined for Illegally Modifying Their Cars
what_it_is: Number of Drivers Issued with Summons and Fined for Illegally Modifying Their Cars

sections.label: Notices to illegally modified vehicles
sections.summary: LTA issued an average of 610 notices of offences per month to owners of illegally modified vehicles over the past two years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In the past two years, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) has issued an average of 610 notices of offences per month to owners of illegally modified vehicles.

sections.label: Action against illegal modification workshops
sections.summary: LTA will investigate and take action against workshops found to have engaged in illegal modification activities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA will investigate and take action against workshops if they are found to have engaged in illegal modification activities.

sections.label: 2017 Road Traffic Act enforcement
sections.summary: In 2017 the Road Traffic Act was updated to strengthen enforcement against workshops, but interviewed vehicle owners have not been cooperative.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Indeed, in 2017, we updated the Road Traffic Act to strengthen our enforcement efforts against workshops.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For instance, we need the vehicle owners to identify the workshops and then, for them to agree to be prosecution witnesses.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So far, the vehicle owners we have interviewed have not been cooperative.

sections.label: Penalties and reduced modification offences
sections.summary: In 2017 penalties for illegal vehicle modification increased, and offences fell from about 1,800 per month in 2015 to about 550 per month in 2020.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In 2017, the penalty for illegal vehicle modification for the vehicle owners was increased to up to $5,000 or up to three months jail, or both for first-time offenders.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Vehicle owners who are found to have modified their exhaust systems, for instance, for second or subsequent times, they will be subjected to more frequent mandatory vehicle inspections of every three to six months, instead of the normal every one to two years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With these strict penalties, as well as our regular enforcement and inspection efforts, we have been able to reduce the number of illegal vehicle modification offences from about 1,800 per month on average in 2015 to about 550 per month on average in 2020.
